name: STEAM@XU Research Immersion (summer pre-college)
what_you_do: Spend one week on campus doing a hands-on research project led by Xavier faculty, with college readiness workshops. Choose a day camp or a residential stay.
pay_detail: 2026 prices: day camp $495 ($545 after May 1, 2026); residential $1,095 ($1,195 after May 1, 2026). Scholarships offered.
deadline_text: The page shows 2026 dates and prices under a 2027 title. The Summer Programs page says 2027 programs are being finalized and that 2027 scholarship applications are open.
how_to_apply: Register online for the day camp or residential option; a separate summer program scholarship application is available. Questions: summerprograms@xavier.edu.
notes: Xavier's Summer Programs page also lists other high school options: Summer in Cincy (one-week residential pre-college), D'Artagnan Summer Business Academy (rising juniors and seniors), CSI Forensics Camp (grades 10 to 12) and STRONG eXplorer Career Camp. Check each page for 2027 prices. High school students who attend may get a $500 to $1,000 award if they later enroll.
